name: Backdraft Bar & Grill
notes: 4 photos: 1 was a chalkboard cocktail/bar menu (drinks-only, skipped); 3 were printed food menu pages (Jr. Firefighter/Mains/Soups, Burgers/Hero/Super-Hero sandwiches, Starters/Greens) and were fully legible.

dishes.name: Spark (Sliders)
dishes.description: 2 slider size of our house made patties, on Hawaii rolls with your choice of cheese drizzled with ketchup and served with our hose roll fries on the side. Comes with a kid drink.

dishes.name: Flare-up (chicken tenders)
dishes.description: Three crispy breaded chicken bites served with ranch and hose roll fries. Comes with a kid drink.

dishes.name: Flash Fire (mac & cheese)
dishes.description: Corkscrew pasta tossed in our creamy cheese blend. Add blazin' bacon or another protein choice for an additional charge. Comes with a kid drink.

dishes.name: Hand line (pizza)
dishes.description: Make your own pizza: a personal dough circle with our signature marinara sauce plus a helping of mozzarella. Comes with a kid drink.

dishes.name: Hook
dishes.description: Lobster stuffed ravioli topped with a creamy lobster sauce and shredded Parmesan cheese.

dishes.name: Spot Fire
dishes.description: Grilled salmon topped with a milder version of our 5150 sauce. Served with avocado cilantro lime rice and glazed carrots.

dishes.name: Pike
dishes.description: Herb encrusted halibut, topped with a white wine lemon butter sauce. Served with avocado cilantro lime rice and glazed carrots.

dishes.name: Engine Co
dishes.description: Fresh Fettuccine tossed with your choice marinara (red), alfredo (white), red & white (pink), pesto (green) or lobster sauce.

dishes.name: Slop-over Chicken
dishes.description: Grilled chicken breast smothered in fresh mozzarella and garlic butter sauce then topped with tomato and avocado slices, old San Luis Rey Downs style. Served with avocado, cilantro, lime rice and glazed carrots.

dishes.name: First Responder Ribeye
dishes.description: 14oz prime, hand cut ribeye, seasoned then grilled to perfection, served with garlic Parmesan mashed potatoes and bacon roasted honey mustard glazed brussel sprouts.

dishes.name: Station House Filet
dishes.description: 8oz prime, hand cut filet, seasoned then grilled to perfection, served with garlic Parmesan mashed potatoes and bacon roasted honey mustard glazed brussel sprouts.

dishes.name: 1 Alarm Chili
dishes.description: Mild, white bean, chicken chili. Add your favorite toppings to spice it up (charges will apply).

dishes.name: Soup of the Day
dishes.description: Please ask your server for details.

dishes.name: Up in Smoke
dishes.description: Triple blend patty topped with Smoked Gouda, Blazin' bacon, 5150 sauce (spicy), grilled onion, lettuce and tomato.

dishes.name: Code 3
dishes.description: Triple blend patty, topped with grilled pineapple, jalapeños, green peppers and onions, lettuce and tomato drizzled with raspberry chipotle sauce.

dishes.name: Bunker Gear
dishes.description: Triple blend patty, topped with pesto, goat cheese, grilled mushrooms, onions, tomato and lettuce.

dishes.name: Mac Daddy
dishes.description: Triple blend patty, topped with Blazin bacon, mac & cheese and a BBQ drizzle.

dishes.name: Ladder
dishes.description: Stack extra rungs (triple blend patties, $5 each) to make your ladder as tall as you would like; choose your cheese and toppings.

dishes.name: Halligan (ham)
dishes.description: Honey smoked ham, your choice of cheese, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and onions on a roll of your liking, smeared with mustard and mayo then drizzled with our Greek style house dressing. Served hot or cold. Half 6" $9, Whole 12" $17.

dishes.name: Brushfire (veggie)
dishes.description: Avocado, bell peppers, black olives, banana peppers, your choice of cheese, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and onions on a roll of your liking, smeared with mustard and mayo then drizzled with our Greek style house dressing. Served cold. Half 6" $9, Whole 12" $17.

dishes.name: Hotshot (Italian)
dishes.description: Honey smoked ham, geno salami, pepperoni, your choice of cheese, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and onions on a roll of your liking, smeared with mustard and mayo then drizzled with our Greek style house dressing. Served hot or cold. Half 6" $9, Whole 12" $17.

dishes.name: Tanker (turkey)
dishes.description: Smoked turkey breast, your choice of cheese, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and onions on a roll of your liking, smeared with mustard and mayo then drizzled with our Greek style house dressing. Served hot or cold. Half 6" $9, Whole 12" $17.

dishes.name: CPR (chicken)
dishes.description: Our version of a Mississippi chicken sandwich. Choose between a crispy or grilled chicken breast, topped with your choice of cheese, pepperoncinis, lettuce, tomatoes, and onions, tossed in our Greek style house dressing, on a roll of your liking, smeared with mustard and mayo then drizzled with our house made ranch. Served hot. Half 6" $10, Whole 12" $18.

dishes.name: Battalion (cheesesteak)
dishes.description: Slices of seasoned steak, joined by sautéed onions and peppers, nestled in a fire-toasted roll of your choice, topped with melted cheese of your liking. Served hot with a side of au jus and horseradish sauce. Half 6" $10, Whole 12" $18.

dishes.name: Jaws of Life (meatball)
dishes.description: Made with tender, hand-rolled meatballs, covered in our house made marinara sauce, then topped with your choice of cheese, served on a roll of your liking. Served hot. Half 6" $10, Whole 12" $18.

dishes.name: Hazmat wings
dishes.description: 1 lb. bone-in chicken wings with your choice of Buffalo, House made BBQ, 5150 (spicy), or Raspberry Chipotle sauce. Served with a side of ranch or blue cheese.

dishes.name: Blazin' Bacon
dishes.description: Sweet and Spicy bacon, a crew favorite. (5 pieces)

dishes.name: AED Eggs
dishes.description: Avocado & eggs deviled then topped with our Blazin' Bacon. (5 pieces)

dishes.name: Mayday Fries
dishes.description: Twisted fries topped with cheddar cheese, grilled chicken, blazin' bacon, scallions and drizzled with our 5150 sauce.

dishes.name: Hose Roll Fries
dishes.description: Twisted fries seasoned with our mild smokey BBQ seasoning blend.

dishes.name: Dispatch Dip
dishes.description: Creamy, roasted garlic, cheese dip, topped with a 5150 drizzle and served with crispy sourdough bread sticks.

dishes.name: Pompiere
dishes.description: Mixed greens, Genoa salami, pepperoni, mozzarella, diced tomatoes, black olives, red onion, banana peppers, topped with our house dressing. Lunch $11, Main $14.

dishes.name: Fire Chief Caesar
dishes.description: Classic Caesar with romaine lettuce, shredded parmesan, croutons and Caesar dressing. Lunch $10, Main $13.

dishes.name: Firehouse Salad
dishes.description: House lettuce mix, topped with turkey, ham, bacon, Blue Cheese, avocado, hardboiled egg, tomatoes & red onions with your choice dressing. Lunch $11, Main $14.

dishes.name: Priority 4
dishes.description: Spinach mix, feta, tomatoes, red onion, bell peppers and avocado, topped with our pesto vinaigrette. Lunch $11, Main $14.
